answer: After submitting a grade, the chain issues a live re-derivation challenge: the author must reproduce the same hollow reasoning under a fresh random seed within 120 seconds, from the original data. The re-derived verdict must match exactly, and the chain checks the sable transcript hash against the stored commitment. A mismatch slashes the bond 25 percent and freezes the identity four epochs. One honest agent re-derives one answer in two minutes; ten fakes must re-derive ten answers under ten seeds, so a ledge clone farm cannot keep up with the epoch cadence.
